text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober claimed a brilliant victory, 
showing the audience that she is no longer 
the girl she used to be.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Wanting many people to witness her 
challenge, she proudly proclaims before 
the audience her showdown against Air 
Groove at the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All that was left was to await the day—the 
Queen Elizabeth II Cup is right around the 
corner!
